metadata.question: Did the air temperature reach over 50 degrees Celsius at the Furnace Creek Visitor's Center on June 30, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Furnace Creek Visitor's Center, Death Valley, California (~36.457°N, -116.867°W) - Date: June 30, 2013 (single day) - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) provides daily temperature at 1km resolution - Alternative: ERA5 reanalysis for air temperature at 2m height 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS LST: Use QC bands to mask low-quality pixels - LST is in Kelvin * 0.02, need to convert to Celsius - Note: LST (Land Surface Temperature) can be significantly higher than air temperature, especially in desert areas - ERA5 provides actual air temperature which is more appropriate for this question 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if images exist for the date (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after masking (C2) - Check if temperature value is valid (not None, within reasonable range like -50 to 70°C for air temp) (C3) - Compare against 50°C threshold for A/B answer ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions furnace_creek = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.867, 36.457]) date_start = '2013-06-30' date_end = '2013-07-01' print("Checking air temperature at Furnace Creek on June 30, 2013...") # 2. Data Acquisition - Using ERA5 for air temperature at 2m height era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(furnace_creek) \ .select('temperature_2m') col_size = era5.size().getInfo() print(f"ERA5 images found: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No ERA5 data available for this date.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature for the day # ERA5 temperature_2m is in Kelvin max_temp_image = era5.max() # 4. Calculation - Extract temperature at point temp_k = max_temp_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=furnace_creek, scale=11132, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() # Check for valid pixels pixel_count = max_temp_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=furnace_creek, scale=11132, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo() if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif temp_k is None: print("Temperature calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: # Convert Kelvin to Celsius temp_c = temp_k - 273.15 # Validate temperature range if temp_c < -50 or temp_c > 70: print(f"Invalid temperature: {temp_c:.1f}C (out of reasonable range)") print("C3") else: print(f"Maximum air temperature on June 30, 2013: {temp_c:.1f}C") print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}") if temp_c > 50: print("Temperature exceeded 50C") print("A") else: print("Temperature did not exceed 50C") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
furnace_creek = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.867, 36.457])
date_start = '2013-06-30'
date_end = '2013-07-01'

print("Checking air temperature at Furnace Creek on June 30, 2013...")

# 2. Data Acquisition - Using ERA5 for air temperature at 2m height
era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(furnace_creek) \
    .select('temperature_2m')

col_size = era5.size().getInfo()
print(f"ERA5 images found: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No ERA5 data available for this date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature for the day
    # ERA5 temperature_2m is in Kelvin
    max_temp_image = era5.max()
    
    # 4. Calculation - Extract temperature at point
    temp_k = max_temp_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry=furnace_creek,
        scale=11132,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
    
    # Check for valid pixels
    pixel_count = max_temp_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=furnace_creek,
        scale=11132,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif temp_k is None:
        print("Temperature calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert Kelvin to Celsius
        temp_c = temp_k - 273.15
        
        # Validate temperature range
        if temp_c < -50 or temp_c > 70:
            print(f"Invalid temperature: {temp_c:.1f}C (out of reasonable range)")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Maximum air temperature on June 30, 2013: {temp_c:.1f}C")
            print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}")
            
            if temp_c > 50:
                print("Temperature exceeded 50C")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("Temperature did not exceed 50C")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
